object_description: two-level cruciform school volume with a covered courtyard
design_condition: The cruciform volume is placed in the garden along the western plot edge, continuing the village fabric between built area and fields while organizing the surrounding garden into linked outdoor rooms.

positive.statement: The simple and effective concept recognizes and affirms the built limits of the surrounding neighborhood.

position.rationale: The broad cruciform footprint provides a visible anchor for its neighborhood-edge relationship.

positive.statement: The school naturally integrates into the continuity of the built fabric between village and fields while measuring its impact.

position.target: built fabric between village and fields
position.rationale: Village-field continuity is not represented, so the western portion of the footprint anchors the site reading.

positive.statement: The proposed extension by elevation continues the established logic efficiently and economically.

position.rationale: Repeated stacked elevation bands visibly support vertical expansion as the cited extension logic.

positive.statement: The covered courtyard is skillfully integrated into the building envelope and functions as a real entrance porch.

position.rationale: The central recessed geometry suggests a courtyard within the cruciform envelope.

positive.statement: The simple S-shaped distribution system provides a balanced sequence of thresholds and varied spaces.

position.rationale: Interior distribution is not visible; the central crossing provides the most useful anchor.

positive.statement: Four large windows across three orientations guarantee high-quality light in every classroom.

position.rationale: Repeated facade openings are visible across the elevation views, though individual classrooms are unresolved.

positive.statement: The identical, homogeneous character of the four facades presents a calm relationship to the near and distant environment.

position.rationale: Repetitive homogeneous facade bands are clearly visible across multiple elevations.

positive.statement: The schoolyard, playground and basketball court are qualified as linked streets and squares, affirming the suburban character.

position.rationale: Outdoor rooms are not individually distinguishable; the eastern exterior surrounds the cruciform volume.

positive.statement: The proposal achieves a precise balance between the theme, site constraints, spatial richness and constructive simplicity.

position.target: theme, site constraints, spatial richness and constructive simplicity
position.rationale: The complete cruciform composition is visible across plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The jury regrets the chosen parking location.

position.rationale: Parking is absent from the sample; a plausible exterior southeast site anchor is used.

negative.statement: The northern access to the site lacks assertiveness in its design.

position.rationale: The stated northern access is anchored along the site’s north edge at ground level.
